answer: Treat every agent as a vertex in a public trust graph and require each new identity to escrow a stake that stays locked through a 30-day probation voyage. During probation its attestations count only when vouched for by established agents, who forfeit part of their own bond if the newcomer is later flagged as a sybil. An attacker building an atlas of fake agents must lock capital for each one and burn real reputation from sponsors, so the cost scales linearly while payoff stays near zero.
